svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Fig. R1 — A ring magnet of 12 sections, each magnetized opposite to its neighbours, and its field outside
field lines traced in 3D from the outer N faces (four per pole at three heights, at equal steps of flux) until they return into an S face; orange N, blue S
Radial: outward and inward in turn
N and S alternate face by face; poles at the section centres
Along the ring: like poles meet at every joint
the octave bar's S N | N S closed into a ring; poles at the joints
Ring 50 mm across, 30 mm bore, 10 mm tall, Br 1.25 T (declared). Each line leaves an N face, arcs over the gap, and enters the neighbouring S face:
twelve arches round the outside, bulging above and below the mid-plane. Field from the surface charge σ = M·n̂ (checked against a point-dipole twin).
